sn_aia_tool.description: Sends a branded commercial lending status email notification to the customer contact. Pushes the AI suggested response into the case field x_snc_pab_ee_tkit_ai_suggested_response and triggers the templated email detailing required document tasks, portal upload link, and submission email.
sn_aia_tool.input_schema: [{"name":"case_sys_id","description":"The sys_id of the lending service case (e.g. 4115ce5ec38fc310b9df5163e4013177)","mandatory":true},{"name":"ai_suggested_response","description":"A concise, professional summary of the application status and outstanding document items to include in the email body.","mandatory":true}]
sn_aia_tool.name: send_lending_application_status_email
